water.zh: 先检查表层土壤，偏干时再考虑浇水。
water.en: Check the upper soil first; consider watering if it feels dry.

check_guidance.zh: 摸一摸表层土壤是否还湿润，观察叶片有无明显变化。土壤仍湿时先不浇水。
check_guidance.en: Feel the upper soil for moisture and look for changes in the leaves. Hold off watering if the soil is still damp.

tip.zh: 避免积水，保持花盆排水通畅。养护需求会随季节和环境变化。
tip.en: Avoid standing water and keep drainage clear. Care needs vary with season and environment.

water.zh: 检查土壤湿度，避免一直保持湿透。
water.en: Check soil moisture and avoid keeping it constantly soaked.

check_guidance.zh: 先检查表层土壤，再观察叶片。叶片变黄有多种可能，不要仅凭叶色决定浇水。
check_guidance.en: Check the upper soil, then inspect the leaves. Yellowing has several possible causes; do not decide to water from leaf color alone.

tip.zh: 可以转动花盆，让不同侧面接触柔和的光线。
tip.en: Rotate the pot occasionally for more even exposure to gentle light.

water.zh: 耐旱，等土壤充分变干后再考虑浇水。
water.en: Drought tolerant; consider watering once the soil has dried well.

check_guidance.zh: 检查土壤是否充分变干，观察叶片是否坚挺。若仍潮湿，暂不需要浇水。
check_guidance.en: Check whether the soil has dried well and observe whether the leaves are firm. If still damp, hold off watering.

tip.zh: 留意积水，不要按固定天数盲目浇水。
tip.en: Watch for standing water; avoid watering blindly on a fixed schedule.

water.zh: 表层土壤偏干时再考虑浇水，保证排水。
water.en: Consider watering when the upper soil feels dry; ensure good drainage.

check_guidance.zh: 检查表层土壤湿度和叶片表面，注意花盆是否积水。
check_guidance.en: Check moisture in the upper soil, inspect the leaves, and look for standing water.

tip.zh: 用柔软湿布轻擦叶片上的灰尘，避免过度移动。
tip.en: Gently wipe dusty leaves with a soft damp cloth; avoid moving it frequently.

water.zh: 观察土壤湿度，避免完全干透或长期积水。
water.en: Monitor soil moisture; avoid complete drying or prolonged standing water.

check_guidance.zh: 触摸表层土壤并观察叶片，叶片低垂不一定只有缺水一种原因。
check_guidance.en: Feel the upper soil and observe the leaves. Drooping can have causes other than lack of water.

tip.zh: 避开强烈直射光，定期检查排水和叶片状态。
tip.en: Avoid harsh direct sun and regularly check drainage and leaf condition.

water.zh: 较耐旱，土壤充分变干后再考虑浇水。
water.en: Drought tolerant; consider watering after the soil dries well.

check_guidance.zh: 检查土壤是否仍潮湿，看看茎叶是否有明显变化。
check_guidance.en: Check whether the soil is still damp and look for noticeable changes in stems and leaves.

tip.zh: 使用排水良好的花盆，避免长期泡在积水里。
tip.en: Use a pot with good drainage and avoid leaving it in standing water.
